summary:
A 15-wide, 2-storey rough-stone farmhouse (x1..15, z11..19) with a steep red-tile roof, brick chimney (top y14), warped-green shuttered windows and a dark-oak lean-to porch on its east side. Beside it, through a lantern-lit gate on the porch axis, lies a walled symmetrical potager (x20..38, z4..32): four timber-edged raised beds with wheat/carrot/potato/beetroot rows, gravel+brick paths crossing at a roofed well, rose arches, espaliered fruit trees, a glasshouse, cold frame and tool shed.
Build as 6 parts (shell, porch+openings, potager, features, interior, grounds). vocab.mjs holds the layout, an OPENINGS table and tested helpers; the roof is a make.sh `mcd roof` cottage-preset step.
concept_subject: A French-country farmstead seen from the street at the north: on the left a two-storey farmhouse of rough mixed grey fieldstone (cobblestone, stone, andesite, a little mossy cobble) on a cobblestone plinth, with pale stone-brick quoins, jambs, lintels and sills, a steep 45-degree red clay-tile gable roof with flared eaves and a ridge along the street, and a tall 2x2 red-brick chimney rising from the ridge's centre. Three bays on the front: shuttered windows either side of a plank front door with a stone step and two lantern posts, three smaller windows above under the eaves, every window flanked by open blue-green (verdigris) shutters. On the garden (east) side a dark-oak-post timber lean-to porch with a spruce-stair roof sloping up to the house wall, hanging lanterns, rails and a bench, with steps down to a gravel yard path. A rough-stone garden wall with a slab cap, the same stone as the house, encloses the potager to the right of the house; a lantern-topped stone-brick gate with a wooden gate leads in from the porch. Inside, a symmetrical kitchen garden: two gravel paths with brick centre lines cross at a stone-brick well with four dark-oak posts, a chain and bucket and a small pyramid roof; four raised beds edged in spruce boards, each with four rows of ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroots and a small water pool; two flowering rose arches over the main path; fruit trees trained flat against the walls as logs with fanned leaves and blossom; a sundial and a stone urn at the ends of the axis; dark-oak lamp posts with lanterns at the crossing. At the back of the garden, a glass glasshouse with a stepped glass roof and birch frame, a low cold frame of glass panes on a plank frame, and a small spruce tool shed with a dark gabled roof. In front a low picket fence, a gravel path to the door lined with roses, lilac, and a low hedge, and behind the house an orchard of apple trees and a woodpile.
concept_palette: dominant rough stone: cobblestone, stone, andesite, mossy_cobblestone; trim: stone_bricks (+ stairs, slabs, walls); roof: red clay tile (bricks, granite, mangrove planks, mud bricks), chimney: bricks; timber: spruce planks/logs/fences, dark_oak logs/fences, oak furniture, birch frame; accent: warped_trapdoor shutters, flowering_azalea_leaves, rose_bush, lilac, lanterns; ground: grass_block, gravel, bricks, farmland, coarse_dirt; crops: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots; glass and glass_pane

parts.name: porch and openings

Nothing at x>=20 or y>=8.

parts.name: garden features

parts.name: interior

Uses table, chair, bed, hearth, furnace, bookshelf, waterCauldron, barrel, chest, lantern.

No tree or leaf at y>=8 in x-2..18, z8..22 (roof zone).
